shrug.criteria: Standing dumbbell shrug with neutral grip, long arms, vertical shoulder elevation and controlled lowering; no rolling shoulders.

reverse-curl.criteria: Standing pronated dumbbell curl, stationary upper arms and straight wrists; controlled elbow flexion and return.

cable-curl.criteria: Low pulley straight-bar curl with underhand grip; elbows stationary and controlled return. Bar remains in both hands and stack follows cable travel.

limits: Procedural demonstration with simplified clothing, hands and equipment; not human motion capture or biomechanical certification. Illustrative one-second pause. No full mesh-collision guarantee. Production and physical Android device pending.
